posts.title: Apple's Reframe: A Moment That Never Was
posts.description: Yesterday’s WWDC ‘26 keynote brought the usual slew of product updates and AI features. Most of the online discourse in my bubble has fixated on Siri AI, but I want to focus on something quieter that Apple demoed for the Photos app: a feature it calls Spatial Reframing or Reframe for short.
